implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Specify needs
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This phase is triggered when a need for new statistics is identified, perhaps resulting from user feedback, or a review is undertaken. It includes all activities associated with engaging stakeholders to identify their detailed statistical needs (current or future), proposing high level solution options and preparing a business case, which may weigh the benefits of addressing these needs against expected costs, risks and other requirements, considering the public good arising from meeting those needs and the implications for respondents, users and other stakeholders. The Specify Needs phase is broken down into six sub-processes (Figure 7), which are presented sequentially, from left to right, but can also occur in parallel, and can be iterative.
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This phase is triggered when a need for new statistics is identified, perhaps resulting from user feedback, or a review is undertaken. It includes all activities associated with engaging stakeholders to identify their detailed statistical needs (current or future), proposing high level solution options, and preparing a business case. In the modernized statistical environment, these activities are increasingly supported by automated and AI-powered processes—ranging from the synthesis and structuring of stakeholder inputs, through the analysis of options, to the automated drafting of business case materials. Routine and repetitive aspects of needs identification, consultation, and documentation are minimized for manual intervention, enabling staff to focus on higher-value tasks: interpreting context, establishing priorities, and making strategic decisions that cannot be automated. The phase thus leverages end-to-end process automation and AI wherever possible, supporting greater efficiency, responsiveness, and quality at the earliest stage of the statistical business process. The Specify Needs phase is broken down into six sub-processes (Figure 7), which are presented sequentially, from left to right, but can also occur in parallel, and can be iterative.
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates and reviews outputs from digital/AI analytics, focusing on critical data assessment and contributing to high-value needs identification instead of routine data assembly. The work-description for Junior Data Analyst states they 'conduct data preparation techniques... ascertaining data quality, conformity to standards, or data origin.' With automation supporting much of the needs identification, this role shifts away from routine gathering and toward validation, assessment, and supporting the high-value analytic and contextual interpretation driven by advanced digital tools.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Identify needs
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process includes the initial investigation and identification of what statistics are needed and what is needed of the statistics. It may be triggered by a new information request from users, an environmental change such as a reduced budget, a periodic review, or respondent feedback. Action plans from evaluations of previous iterations of the production cycle (including from respondent feedback) or from other programmes might provide an input to this sub-process. It also includes consideration of practice amongst other (national and international) statistical organisations producing similar data and the methods used by those organisations.
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process includes the initial investigation and identification of what statistics are needed and what is needed of the statistics. In the modern process, AI and automated tools are used to continuously scan for new information requests from users, detect relevant environmental changes, and aggregate respondent feedback and evaluation action plans. These technologies also benchmark needs by automatically referencing practices among other (national and international) statistical organizations. Automation supports the collation, analysis, and structuring of these triggers for new or changed statistics, while staff focus their expertise on interpreting context, confirming significance, and ensuring response to complex or emergent requirements.
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Partners with automation in collecting/classifying needs and maintains QA on AI-generated synthesis. The work-description includes 'conducts data preparation techniques,' signaling their skillset matches the shift to supporting and validating the digital environment's outputs—checking AI/automation-derived identification and structuring of needs and confirming alignment with statistical and organizational standards.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Check data availability and suitability
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process checks whether current sources of data could meet user requirements and the conditions under which they would be available, including any restrictions on their use. An assessment of possible alternatives would normally include research into potential administrative or other non-statistical sources of data (e.g. privately-held data or “Big Data”), to: Determine whether they would be suitable for use for statistical purposes (e.g. the extent to which administrative concepts match data requirements, and whether the timeliness and quality of the data, security, and continuity of data supply are suitable); Assess the division of responsibilities between data suppliers and the statistical organisation...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process systematically checks whether current sources of data could meet user requirements and the conditions under which they would be available, including any restrictions on their use. Existing data holdings must be exhaustively investigated and prioritized first, followed by a search for relevant administrative and alternative data sources; the option to conduct new surveys is only considered if these avenues prove insufficient to meet data needs. The subject matter sponsor holds sole accountability for certifying that all relevant avenues for data have been thoroughly explored and that the suitability, timeliness, and quality of any proposed source have been rigorously assessed. To expedite and strengthen the acquisition of administrative and alternative data, a center of expertise works collaboratively with subject matter specialists to support negotiations, acquisition logistics, and the establishment of legal or operational agreements where needed. When multiple avenues have been assessed and documented, a strategy for filling any remaining gaps is prepared. This sub-process also encompasses the assessment and possible updates to the legal framework for data collection, ensuring fit-for-purpose, respondent-efficient, and timely data acquisition and usage.
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Assesses and validates quality, timeliness, and coverage of automated or alternative data source QA routines, leveraging technical skills in data sourcing. The work-description's reference to 'knowledge of data science and its life cycle...' and 'data preparation techniques' equips the Junior Data Analyst to evaluate, validate, and support automation-enabled checks of data availability/suitability before survey options are pursued.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Design
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This phase describes the development and design activities, and any associated practical research work needed to define the statistical outputs, variables, methodologies, collection instruments and operational processes, with due regard to other requirements such as security. It includes all the design elements needed to define or refine the statistical products or services identified in the business case. This phase specifies all relevant metadata, in accordance with the standards and corporate policies, ready for use later in the business process, as well as quality assurance procedures...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This phase describes the development and design activities, and any associated practical research work needed to define the statistical outputs, variables, methodologies, collection instruments, and operational processes—with a strong emphasis on automation, AI-powered tools, and digital interoperability. Automated and AI-driven processes play a central role in drafting specifications, aligning with corporate and international standards, generating and enriching metadata, simulating system interactions, and iterating design improvements...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates, QAs, and contextualizes AI/automation-generated system, component, and metadata design for technical fitness and standard compliance. The Junior Data Analyst's 'conducts data preparation techniques' and 'knowledge of data science and its lifecycle...' now support the hands-on testing, evaluation, and improvement of AI-enabled design elements before implementation.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Design variables
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process defines the variables to be collected via the collection instrument, as well as any other variables that will be derived from them in sub-process 5.5 (Derive new variables and units), and any statistical or geospatial classifications that will be used...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process defines the variables to be collected via the collection instrument and any that will be derived for analysis or dissemination, with a strong emphasis on standards compliance, automation, and machine-actionability. All variable definitions and supporting metadata must comply with national and international standards (e.g., SDMX), structured in machine-actionable formats and managed through prescribed data management tools (such as Aria or Colectica)...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates and enriches AI/LLM-suggested variable sets for metadata completeness and compliance with standards, manages machine-actionable content. This is based on the Junior Data Analyst's responsibility for 'data preparation techniques, data cleansing, data transformation, data validation,' now increasingly dedicated to testing and confirming outputs from AI/LLM-driven metadata and variable creation tools.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Design collection
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process prepares a collection strategy for the data, and determines the most appropriate collection instruments and methods, which may depend on the type of data collection, the collection unit type (enterprise, person, or other) and the available sources of data...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process prepares a collection strategy for the data and determines the most appropriate collection instruments and methods, with a strategic emphasis on automation, AI/ML, and passive acquisition. Where possible, the design must prioritize passive, administrative, and already-available sources of data; surveys or direct solicitation are employed only when all other avenues are exhausted or cannot provide suitable data...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Vets, QAs, and provides technical support for automated, digital-first data collection designs (including passive models, APIs, and AI-driven logic). The role’s inclusion of 'data capture and acquisition, data extraction, warehousing...' shows they are positioned to interface between automated collection strategy design and hands-on, real-world practices.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Design frame and sample
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process applies especially to processes which involve data collection based on sampling, such as through statistical surveys, but it may also apply to other types of data collection such as census or register-based (e.g., filtering of registers based on the target population). It identifies and specifies the population of interest, defines a sampling frame (and, where necessary, the register from which it is derived), and determines the most appropriate sampling criteria and methodology (which could include complete enumeration)...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process, which applies to all statistical processes involving sampling, is built around digital automation, flexibility, and data quality by design. Whenever frames or registers from administrative, alternative, or partner-held sources are used, partners are expected and supported to apply AI-driven data cleaning and quality control processes prior to data ingestion by Statistics Canada—improving coverage, comparability, and downstream analytic value...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Supports QA and supervision for AI-driven and partner-prepared frames; ensures flexible design and automated integration. Their technical skills from 'data extraction, data cleansing, data transformation, data validation' directly support involvement in the review and refinement of digital, automated sampling frame design and validation.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Design processing and analysis
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process designs the statistical methodology to be applied during the Process and Analyse phases. This can include, among others, specification of routines and rules for coding, editing and imputation, which may vary based on the means of data collection and source of data...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process designs the statistical methodology to be applied during the Process and Analyse phases, with a core emphasis on standards-based automation, AI enablement, and digital interoperability. Specifications for routines and rules covering coding, editing, imputation, validation, and data integration/estimation are required to be implemented, where practical, using automated frameworks and AI/ML-driven tools...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Implements, reviews, and tests automated/AI analytical routines and assures traceability of pipeline design. Their 'knowledge of data science... modeling, summarization, reporting' supports their new focus on deploying and validating analytical modules that are increasingly automated and standards-driven.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Design production systems and workflows
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process determines the workflow from data collection to dissemination, taking an overview of all the processes required within the whole production process and ensuring that they fit together efficiently with no gaps or redundancies.
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process determines the workflow from data collection to dissemination, ensuring all production processes are seamlessly integrated, modular, and event-driven, with automation and AI/ML supporting orchestration, monitoring, and transitions. Workflows are designed to minimize manual intervention and maximize real-time coordination...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Supports technical quality for modular, automation-ready digital pipelines and smooth business process transitions. Their participation in 'project teams... data management, research and analysis' now involves QA of workflow automation and digital integration, boosting process efficiency.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Build
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This phase builds and tests the production solution to the point where it is ready for use in the 'live' environment. The outputs of the Design phase are assembled and configured in this phase to create the complete operational environment...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This phase builds and tests the production solution to the point where it is ready for use in the 'live' environment, leveraging modular automation and AI-driven assembly at every step. The outputs of the Design phase are assembled and configured using digital orchestration pipelines that prioritize reusability, traceability, and compliance...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: QA, troubleshoot exceptions, and oversee integration and deployment of automated or AI-configured production elements across the build pipeline. Their duties in 'data preparation techniques', 'system configuration,' and 'data validation' are increasingly shaped by hands-on testing and oversight of automated system deployment rather than manual build.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Reuse or build processing and analysis components
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process describes the activities to reuse existing components or build new components needed for the Process and Analyse phases, as designed in the Design phase...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process describes the activities to reuse existing components or build new, automation-ready components needed for the Process and Analyse phases. All components—whether dashboard modules, transformation functions, geospatial and information services, or workflow management tools—must be designed for modularity, AI/ML-driven orchestration, and seamless integration into digital, event-driven workflows...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates, configures, and ensures technical interoperability of AI/automation-based components. As described—'data preparation techniques', 'participates in project teams for data management, research and analysis'—their analytical and technical knowledge allows them to work at the interface between new tools and legacy/tested workflows.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Configure workflows
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process configures the workflows, systems and transformations used within the business processes, from data collection through to dissemination...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process configures the workflows, systems, and transformations used within all business processes—from data collection through to dissemination—to form modular, automation-ready data pipelines...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Tests, validates, advises on and monitors digital workflow configuration in support of seamless automation. Their grounding in 'data management, research and analysis' ensures their support for robust and effective automation configuration.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Create frame and select sample
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process establishes the frame and selects the sample for this iteration of the collection, as specified in sub-process 2.4 (Design frame and sample)...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process establishes the frame and selects the sample for this iteration of the collection, as specified in sub-process 2.4 (Design frame and sample). Automated and AI/LLM-driven technologies are employed to perform record linkage, deduplication, and harmonization across administrative, alternative, and legacy data sources, ensuring the sampling frame is accurate, comprehensive, and consistent...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates, QAs, and interprets automated frame construction outputs; oversees automated frame construction and addresses edge cases. Their expertise in 'data extraction, data cleansing, data transformation, data validation' is crucial for ensuring accuracy and completeness in AI-driven frame creation.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Process
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This phase describes the processing of input data and their preparation for analysis. It is made up of sub-processes that integrate, classify, check, clean, and transform input data, so that they can be analysed and disseminated as statistical outputs...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This phase describes the processing of input data and their preparation for analysis, using modular, version-controlled, automation- and AI/ML-enabled digital workflows. Every sub-process—integrate, classify, check, clean, and transform input data—is configured for event-driven orchestration, reproducibility, and end-to-end automation wherever feasible, ensuring high speed, quality, and consistency...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Expert in QA and oversight of modular, automated AI-driven processing workflows for integrating, classifying, checking, cleaning, and transforming data. The work-description’s 'data extraction, data cleansing, data validation, conformity to standards, or data origin' is the foundation for their vital quality and oversight function as processing becomes digital-first and automated.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Integrate data
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process integrates data from one or more sources...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process integrates data from one or more sources using automated, modular, and AI/LLM-powered pipelines. Record linkage, deduplication, and harmonization are conducted with machine learning and automation as the core methods, minimizing manual intervention...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Supervises integration automation, reviews quality and completeness, and handles exceptions flagged by automated harmonization routines. Their technical activities and experience with 'data extraction, data cleansing, data transformation, data validation' are especially pertinent to this digital function.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Classify and code
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process classifies and codes the input data...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process classifies and codes input data using modular, automated, and AI/ML-powered pipelines that leverage SDMX and other international standards. Text descriptions and response data are classified and coded primarily by LLM/AI models...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Configures, validates, and QAs code/classification automation, monitors ambiguous case escalation to experts, and maintains standards. The skillset for 'data preparation techniques' and 'data validation' is now oriented toward overseeing event-driven, modular application of automated code assignment.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Review and validate
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process examines data to identify potential problems, errors and discrepancies such as outliers, item non-response, miscoding and duplicate records...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process examines and validates data using modular, automated digital tools and AI/LLM-enabled validation routines. ML and LLMs flag missing data, inconsistencies, outliers, and errors, routing only ambiguous, complex, or systemic anomalies to human experts for further investigation and correction...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Interprets automated reports on data flagged for review, addresses complex anomalies, maintains audit trails, and revises QA logic as needed. Their 'ascertaining data quality, conformity to standards' is essential as validation is taken over by AI, with the analyst focusing on error escalation and rule refinement.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Edit and impute
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: Where data are considered incorrect, missing, unreliable, outdated, or duplicated, new values may be inserted, or erroneous data may be removed in this sub-process...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: Where data are considered incorrect, missing, unreliable, outdated, or duplicated, edits and imputations are made through automated, modular, and AI/LLM-powered digital pipelines. LLMs and ML modules suggest and apply replacements or corrections as standard...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Provides QA, review, and oversight on automated imputation and edit routines, validates audit trails and resolves unresolved data issues. Their foundational expertise in 'data cleansing, data transformation, data validation' gives them the standing to judge and refine automated edit processes.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Derive new variables and units
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process derives data for variables and units that are not explicitly provided in the collection, but are needed to deliver the required outputs...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process derives data for variables and units needed to deliver required outputs using modular, automation- and AI-powered methods. Digital pipelines apply arithmetic and formula-based logic, iterating as needed and recording all derivations and transformations with a traceable audit trail...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates AI–powered derivations, checks audit trails, and ensures compliance of automated derivations and transformations. Their experience in 'modeling, summarization, reporting' translates to quality assessment and guidance for derived variable procedures.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Calculate weights
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process creates weights for unit data records according to the methodology developed in sub-process 2.5 (Design processing and analysis)...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process creates weights for unit data records through modular, event-driven automated algorithms, according to methodologies determined in phase 2.5. All steps and formulae, including adjustments for non-response or benchmarking, are handled digitally and recorded in procedural audit logs...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Oversees QA and diagnostics for automated weighting calculations, interprets output and escalates or reviews novel and diagnostic cases. Their statistical data analysis capabilities are relevant to exception handling and evaluation of weighting outcomes.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Calculate aggregates
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process creates aggregate data and population totals from microdata or lower-level aggregates...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process creates aggregate data and population totals using modular, digital automation pipelines, generating all statistical summaries, weights, and dispersion measures hands-free. Event-driven algorithms apply the full range of aggregations, error calculations, and summary statistic logic...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates, documents, supervises, and reviews automated aggregations, error calculations and summary statistics. Their work in 'modeling, summarization, reporting, data quality' forms the foundation for effective digital QA and exceptions management.

implicated phases and sub-processes.title: Finalise data files
implicated phases and sub-processes.original description: This sub-process brings together the results of the other sub-processes in this phase in a data set (either micro- or macro-data), which is used as the input to the Analyse phase...
implicated phases and sub-processes.updated description: This sub-process brings together and finalizes the results of all previous sub-processes in the phase, producing data files (micro- or macro-level) in fully standardized, open, and machine-actionable formats by default...
implicated phases and sub-processes.justification: Validates, documents, and ensures auditability and machine-actionability of final datasets for technical compliance. Their participation in 'data preparation, documentation, technical guidance' is vital for interoperable, standards-ready final dataset hand-off.
